# adds_computer (Resource)

Manages an Active Directory computer account by executing PowerShell on a remote Windows host.

This pre-stages or reconciles the directory object for a machine; it does not join a host to the domain. Attributes populated by a joined machine, such as `operating_system`, are read back but not managed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "adds_computer" "web01" {
  name        = "web01"
  path        = "Contoso/Servers"
  description = "Pre-staged account for the web01 host"

  dns_host_name = "web01.contoso.local"
  location      = "Oslo DC1"
  managed_by    = adds_group.web_admins.distinguished_name

  service_principal_names = [
    "HOST/web01.contoso.local",
    "HOST/web01",
  ]

  kerberos_encryption_type = ["AES128", "AES256"]
  enabled                  = true
}

resource "adds_group" "web_admins" {
  name  = "Web Admins"
  path  = "Contoso/Groups"
  scope = "Global"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Computer name (the `CN`). Changing this renames the account in place.
- `path` (String) Container holding the account. Accepts a slash-delimited path relative to the domain root (for example `Computers` or `Contoso/Servers`), a relative distinguished name such as `CN=Computers`, or a full distinguished name. Slash segments are always OU names. Changing this moves the account.

### Optional

- `account_not_delegated` (Boolean) Mark the account as sensitive and not able to be delegated.
- `compound_identity_supported` (Boolean) Advertise support for Kerberos armoring / compound identity (Dynamic Access Control).
- `description` (String) Description.
- `display_name` (String) Display name (`displayName`).
- `dns_host_name` (String) Fully qualified DNS host name of the machine, for example `web01.contoso.local`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the account is enabled.
- `kerberos_encryption_type` (Set of String) Kerberos encryption types the account supports. Any of `None`, `DES`, `RC4`, `AES128`, `AES256`. Omit to leave the Active Directory default in place.
- `location` (String) Physical location of the machine (`location`).
- `managed_by` (String) Owner of this computer object (`managedBy`). Accepts a distinguished name, `objectGUID`, SID, `DOMAIN\name` or `sAMAccountName`. The resolved distinguished name is published as `managed_by_dn`.
- `protected_from_accidental_deletion` (Boolean) Protect the account from accidental deletion. This is not a stored attribute: it adds Deny access control entries for `Everyone` on `Delete` and `DeleteTree`.
- `sam_account_name` (String) Pre-Windows 2000 logon name. Defaults to `name`. Active Directory appends a `$`, so a trailing `$` you supply is ignored and the remainder must be at most 15 characters. Both `web01` and `web01$` refer to the same account.
- `service_principal_names` (Set of String) Service principal names registered on the account, for example `HOST/web01.contoso.local`. This set is authoritative: names not listed are removed.
- `trusted_for_delegation` (Boolean) Trust the account for unconstrained Kerberos delegation.
- `user_principal_name` (String) User principal name of the account.

### Read-Only

- `distinguished_name` (String) Distinguished name of the account. Changes when the account is renamed or moved.
- `id` (String) Terraform resource identifier. Equals the account `objectGUID`, which is stable across renames and moves.
- `managed_by_dn` (String) Resolved distinguished name of `managed_by`.
- `operating_system` (String) Operating system reported by the joined machine (`operatingSystem`). Empty until a host joins with this account.
- `operating_system_version` (String) Operating system version reported by the joined machine (`operatingSystemVersion`). Empty until a host joins with this account.
- `sid` (String) Security identifier of the account.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Computer accounts are imported by objectGUID, which is stable across renames and moves.
terraform import adds_computer.web01 "b3f2b9a0-1234-4a85-a7a3-9bcbb6a41d02"
```
